title: Perkunas Kaunas celebrate U19 League title
description: Perkunas Kaunas clinched U19 League title. They outscored their cross-town rivals Zalgiris 83-76 in the championship game to conquer the trophy. Dominykas Grunkis (164-PG-2007) stepped up with 27 points to lead the champions. Perkunas limited their opponents to just 10 points in the first period to gain a 6-point lead. Zalgiris fired 21 points in the second frame to eke out a 31-30 halftime advantage. But Perkunas stepped on the gas in the second half. They unleashed 53 points in the second half to rally to the victory. Justas Juozaitis (201-F-2006) had 21 points in the win. Nedas Vydmantas (186-PG-2006) answered with 26 points for Zalgiris.
